# Page Purpose and Non-Redundancy Inventory

Use this record before ChatGPT creates or materially revises production-intent
visual authority. It is required by the V0/V1 gates in
`docs/governance/OWNER_VISUAL_INTEGRITY_STANDARD.md`.

## A. Scope and approval

- Initiative / slice:
- Page or surface:
- Member need this page serves:
- Named capability and visual authority status:
- Known source / capability limits:
- Prepared by / date:
- Pete inventory approval / date:
- Inventory status: Draft / Pete approved / Superseded

## B. Meaningful item decisions

Every meaningful visible page item, card, control, and status receives its own
row. `Meaningful` means it changes what a member can understand, decide, do,
where they can go, what they can see, or what the page claims is true. Repeated
decoration may be grouped only when it carries none of those meanings.

| Item | Member purpose | Source / capability truth | Action / destination | Privacy, audience, and lifecycle | Unique relationship on this page | Decision: Keep / Change / Combine / Remove / Defer | Owner rationale |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| _Example: Ask Slate prompt_ | Optional private help shaping a draft | Planned / unavailable until the authorized service exists | Opens a proposal workflow when available; otherwise explains unavailability | Private; proposal only; never publishes or saves automatically | The only contextual intelligence entry point; not a duplicate page-level chatbot | Defer | Requires the Ask Slate package and privacy gate |

## C. Combined, removed, and deferred items

Record the destination or replacement for every non-Keep decision. A visual
lock may not reintroduce one as a meaningful item without a new approved row.

| Item | Decision | Replacement / destination / reason | Revisit trigger |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

## D. Lock check

- [ ] Every meaningful page item, card, control, and status has a distinct row.
- [ ] Repeated decoration is grouped only because it carries no separate member
      purpose, claim, action, destination, privacy/audience/lifecycle meaning,
      or product relationship.
- [ ] Each retained item has a distinct relationship; no two visible objects
      silently claim the same job without an explicit Combine decision.
- [ ] The exact member action and destination are truthful, including disabled,
      unavailable, illustrative, and future states.
- [ ] Privacy, audience, lifecycle, and canonical/proposal boundaries are
      truthful.
- [ ] Pete approves this inventory before the visual lock.
- [ ] The locked visual introduces no unlisted meaningful item.
